PRAYERS 
 
Pursuant to an order of the Assembly dated October 16, 2023, the Assembly omitted petitions.

RITTEN QUESTIONS 
  
The order of the day being called for question nos. 156  to 161, pursuant to rule 21(6), the questions were 
converted and orders for return were issued. (see appendix) 
 
 
THIRD READINGS / TROISIÈME LECTURE 
 
Bill No. 137 — The Education (Parents’ Bill of Rights) Amendment Act, 2023 
Projet de loi no 137 — Loi modificative de 2023 sur l’éducation (Déclaration des droits des parents) 
 
Moved by the Hon. Mr. Cockrill: That Bill No. 137 
— The Education (Parents’ Bill of Rights) 
Amendment Act, 2023 be now read the  third time 
and passed under its title. 
 
L’hon. M. Cockrill propose: Que le projet de loi n° 
137 — Loi modificative de 2023 sur l’éducation 
(Déclaration des droits des parents) soit maintenant lu 
une troisième fois et adopté, portant le titre indiqué.

A debate arising , the Speaker interrupted 
proceedings pursuant to an order of the Assembly 
dated October 16, 2023. The question being put on 
the motion, it was agreed to on the following 
recorded division: 
Il s’élève un débat et le Président interrompe la 
séance conformément à l’Ordre de l’Assemblée du 
16 octobre 2023. La question, mise aux voix, est 
adoptée par le vote suivant:

ROYAL ASSENT / SANCTION ROYALE 
 
11:38 a.m. 
 
His Honour the Lieutenant Governor, having 
entered the Chamber, took his seat upon the Throne. 
Son Honneur le Lieutenant -gouverneur fait son 
entrée dans la Chambre et prend place au Trône. 
 
The Speaker addressed His Honour: 
 
Le Président s’adresse à Son Honneur: 
 
MAY IT PLEASE YOUR HONOUR: 
 
QU’IL PLAISE À VOTRE HONNEUR: 
 
This Legislative Assembly at its present session has 
passed a bill which, in the name of the Assembly, I 
Cette Assemblée législative, au cours de la présente 
session, a adopté un projet de loi que je  présente à 
=====PAGE
Friday, October 20, 2023  3 
 
present to Y our Honour and to whic h bill  I 
respectfully request Your Honour’s assent. 
 
Votre Honneur, au nom de l’Assemblée, et que  je 
demande respectueusement à V otre Honneur de 
sanctionner. 
 
The Clerk of the Assembly then read the title of the 
bill that had been passed as follows: 
Le Greffier de l’Assemblée a donné lecture du titre 
du projet de loi adopté comme suit: 
 
Bill No. 137 — The Education (Parents’ Bill of Rights) Amendment Act, 2023 
Projet de loi no 137 — Loi modificative de 2023 sur l’éducation (Déclaration des droits des parents) 
 
His Honour the Lieutenant Governor then replied: 
“In His Majesty’s name, I assent to this bill.” 
 
Son Honneur le Lieutenant -gouverneur alors a 
répondu: “Au nom de Sa Majesté , je sanctionne ce 
projet de loi.” 
 
His Honour then retired from the Chamber. 
 
Son Honneur se retire de la Chambre. 
 
11:39 a.m. 
 
 
MOTION TO ADJOURN THE SITTING 
 
On motion of the Hon. Mr. Harrison (Meadow Lake): 
 
Ordered, That when this Assembly adjourns at the end of this sitting day, in accordance with the parliamentary 
calendar, it shall stand adjourned until 10 a.m. on October 25th, 2023, unless earlier recalled by the Speaker 
upon the request of the government. 
 
 
On motion of the Hon. Mr. Harrison (Meadow Lake): 
 
Ordered, That this Assembly do now adjourn.   
 
Pursuant to an order made October 20, 2023, the Assembly adjourned at 11:41 a.m. until Wednesday, October 
25, 2023 at 10:00 a.m. 
 
 
 Hon. Randy Weekes 
 Speaker

I Appendix Friday, October 20, 2023 
 
QUESTIONS ORDERED FOR RETURN 
 
The following written questions were converted and orders for return were issued:  
 
Return no. 146 (Ms. Ritchie): 
To the Minister Responsible for Water Security Agency, the reason why the water level in Cumberland 
Lake been permitted to reach dangerously low levels, risking the drinking water supply for the Northern 
Village of Cumberland House. 
 
Return no. 147 (Ms. Ritchie): 
To the Minister Responsible for Water Security Agency, the reason why adequate water outflows are 
not being maintained from Tobin Lake to safely meet downstream needs in the Northern Village of 
Cumberland House. 
 
Return no. 148 (Ms. Ritchie): 
To the Minister Responsible for Water Security Agency, the emergency plans that are in place to ensure 
a safe supp ly of water for the Northern Village of Cumberland House as freeze- up and winter 
approaches. 
 
Return no. 149 (Ms. Ritchie): 
To the Minister Responsible for Water Security Agency, the reason why the Northern Village of 
Cumberland House has not been contacte d directly by Water Security Agency officials and been 
informed about current and forecasted low water levels in Cumberland Lake that is their only source of 
drinking water. 
 
Return no. 150 (Ms. Ritchie): 
To the Minister Responsible for Water Security Agency, what is being done to restore the lake levels 
in Cumberland Lake to within a safe level to meet the requirements of the Northern Village of 
Cumberland House, as well as those of local commercial, traditional and ecosystem needs. 
 
Return no. 151 (Ms. Ritchie): 
To the Minister Responsible for Water Security Agency, how the dangerously low water levels in 
Cumberland Lake conform with the Cumberland House Water Management Agreement and what is 
being done to restore water levels to meet the wate r needs of the Northern Village of Cumberland 
House.
